#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

class Task {
public:
    void execute() {
        int testCases = 1;
        for (int tc = 0; tc < testCases; tc++) {
            compute();
        }
    }

private:
    void compute() {
        int n;
        cin >> n;
        
        vector<vector<int>> dp(2 * n, vector<int>(n + 1, 0));
        dp[0][1] = 1;

        for (int step = 1; step < 2 * n; step++) {
            for (int pos = 0; pos <= n; pos++) {
                if (pos + 1 <= n) {
                    dp[step][pos + 1] = (dp[step][pos + 1] + dp[step - 1][pos]) % MOD;
                }
                if (pos - 1 >= 0) {
                    dp[step][pos - 1] = (dp[step][pos - 1] + dp[step - 1][pos]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        int total = 0;
        for (int step = 2 * n - 2; step >= 0; step -= 2) {
            for (int pos = 1; pos <= n; pos += 2) {
                if (pos <= 2 * n - 1 - step) {
                    total = (total + dp[step][pos]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        cout << total << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    // Try to open input.txt, if it fails, use standard input
    ifstream infile("input.txt");
    if (infile.is_open()) {
        cin.rdbuf(infile.rdbuf());
    }
    
    Task task;
    task.execute();
    
    return 0;
}
